dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual convergence of the lateral margins from the mid-section toward the posterior frame limit.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical convex bulge on the left lateral margin relative to the more linear right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: High-intensity mature white with a neutral grayscale median.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced longitudinal shadow-casting ridge along the central dorsal axis of the mid-to-posterior region.

other_distinctive_markers: Dark oval aperture (blowhole) clearly visible on the anterior dorsal midline.
